items.title: 当编码不再是瓶颈：Berkeley RDI 提出软件自主开发三级框架 / When Coding Stops Being the Bottleneck

sources.title: 当编码不再是瓶颈：Berkeley RDI 提出软件自主开发三级框架 / When Coding Stops Being the Bottleneck
sources.title_zh: 当编码不再是瓶颈：Berkeley RDI 提出软件自主开发三级框架
sources.title_en: When Coding Stops Being the Bottleneck
sources.title_original: When Coding Stops Being the Bottleneck
sources.summary: Berkeley RDI等机构提出三级软件自主开发框架：代码自主（AI完成设计与实现，人类决定构建内容并审核PR）、流水线自主（AI运行从设计到部署的全流程，人类仅评估结果）、需求自主（AI自主决定构建内容）。该框架旨在为能力声明、部署选择与问责提供清晰分类。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic团队用16个并行Claude agent以不到2万美元构建了一个工作C编译器，文章提出了三级软件自主开发水平框架，解释了AI如何彻底改变软件工程。

sources.title_original: 浪费20亿Token后，我开源了帮Agent定义目标的Leader.skill
sources.summary: 作者开源了Leader.skill，用于将模糊的人类需求转化为Agent可独立执行数小时的目标任务书。该Skill基于"目标七问"方法论，涵盖目的、完成态、反作弊、边界等维度，并推荐用Claude Fable 5或Kimi K3规划目标，再交由GPT-5.6 Sol或GLM-5.2等模型长程执行。项目已开源。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者在浪费20亿Token后，开源了帮助Agent定义目标的Leader.skill，分享如何通过明确目标提升AI任务执行效率，避免资源浪费。

sources.summary: It pisses me off to reflect that they can sit on works until copyright expires, keeping them out of print. There's no real need for any of these so-called rare books to be rare while they're under copyright. And related to this, the books that are in print are mostly only in print in the shittiest way. sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本文批评现代出版业标准下降，指出17-18世纪的精装书至今完好，而21世纪大多数作品只提供一次性格式，并提议修改版权法让其他出版商能重印绝版书。

sources.summary: 🦔AI companies are bulk-buying rare books, scanning them through high-speed machines that cut the spines off, and shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to a million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are premium because they're free of AI-generated text. A federal judge ruled the practice is fair use because eliminating the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to obtain "all th
sources.recommend_reason_zh: AI公司批量购入珍本后切脊高速扫描并销毁，ISBNdb能匿名订购百万本书，Anthropic甚至雇用前Google Books负责人以获取“世界上所有的书”。18世纪植物学文本的最后三本也被送去粉碎。
